nodes.name: Chainwhip
nodes.description: Swing a chain at an enemy dealing 8 + 45% AP + 25% SP Physical damage and silencing them for 2 seconds, generating a large amount of threat.If you successfully interrupt an enemy, this will refund 20% of the cooldown.

nodes.name: Suffuse
nodes.description: Embrace your mortal body, restoring 103 + 10% Stamina health every 3 sec, scaling with Stamina and defense rating.Lasts 3 sec for each Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Chains of Malice
nodes.description: Lock an enemy down with magical chains, stunning them and dragging them with you for 5 seconds.Every 1 sec, the enemy will suffer 16 Physical damage.Enemies that cannot be stunned or rooted cannot be dragged.

nodes.name: Xorothian Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Strength by 5%.

nodes.name: Demonfire Plating
nodes.description: Reduces your damage taken by -2% and increases your Stamina by 3%.

nodes.name: War Pig
nodes.description: Increases your Physical damage dealt by 4%.

nodes.name: Spiked Chains
nodes.description: Your Chainwhip now deals 321 + 30% AP additional Physical damage, increased by 100% on Humanoids.

nodes.name: Boiling Blood
nodes.description: Casting Suffuse now increases your healing received by 25% for the first 6 seconds of it's duration.

nodes.name: Suffusion of Essence
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Suffuse by 2 sec for each Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Bloodied Blade
nodes.description: Melee Physical damage dealt now generates a stack of Demon's Blood.

nodes.name: Black Shield
nodes.description: Consume all of your Demon's Blood stacks to create a demonic shield that absorbs 860 damage, increased by 20% per Demon's Blood stack, for 30 seconds.

nodes.name: Omen of Rage
nodes.description: Periodic damage and healing done has a 10% chance to grant a stack of Demonfire.

nodes.name: Demon Heart
nodes.description: Embrace your inner demon, instantly generating 6 stacks of Demonfire and 50 Rage.

nodes.name: Brimstone's Blood
nodes.description: Increases the chance of gaining a stack of Demon's Blood by 25%.

nodes.name: Ragefist
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Rage by 10 and reduces the duration of disarm effects against you by -15%.

nodes.name: Hell Blender
nodes.description: Casting Meatsaw now has a 40% chance to refund 10 Rage.

nodes.name: Darkrider
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Mark spells by 50%.

nodes.name: Demonic Rage
nodes.description: Generating Demon's Blood stacks now generates 1 additional Rage.

nodes.name: Juggernaut
nodes.description: Consume all of your Demon's Blood to become a juggernaut, reducing all damage taken by -30% for 10 seconds. For the duration, you heal every 3 sec for 6 + 10% AP, increased per Demon's Blood stack consumed.

nodes.name: Hellstriker
nodes.description: Direct critical strikes now increase the duration of Hellrider on you by 2 sec.

nodes.name: Burning Rage
nodes.description: Enrage, generating 15 Rage every 1 sec and making you immune to incapacitate, banish, and polymorph effects for 6 seconds.Usable while incapacitated, banished, or polymorphed.

nodes.name: Demonskin
nodes.description: Each stack of Demon's Blood also increases your Armor by 1%.

nodes.name: Hellbound Charge
nodes.description: 2 Charges, 60 sec rechargeBriefly jump atop your Xorothian Warsteed, increasing your movement speed by 70% for 3 seconds.Usable while indoors, but you cannot use your Mounted Combat abilities while riding your Warsteed in this way.

nodes.name: Dismemberment
nodes.description: Damaging abilities that spend Demonfire now reduces the target's healing received by -20% for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Warpath
nodes.description: While Unleash Pestilence is active it now protects your movement speed from being reduced below 90% of normal speed.

nodes.name: Hellbreaker
nodes.description: Casting Unleash Pestilence now removes all active movement impairing effects from you.

nodes.name: Xorothian Finesse
nodes.description: Increases your chance to parry by 5%.

nodes.name: Mounted Champion
nodes.description: Your Xorothian Warsteed is now instant cast and prevents roots and slows for 2 sec when cast, but now has a 10 sec cooldown.

nodes.name: Mounted Reaver
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of all Mounted Combat abilities by -20%.

nodes.name: Taskmaster
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3% plus an additional 15% against Demons.

nodes.name: Rage of Xoroth
nodes.description: Your critical strikes now enrage you, increasing your melee attack speed by 15%.

nodes.name: Heart of Xoroth
nodes.description: Allows Demon's Blood to stack 5 additional times.

nodes.name: Brute Strength
nodes.description: Increases your critical damage dealt with Physical attacks by 10% and increases the range of Flesh Hook, Chains of Malice, and Chainwhip by 5 yds.

nodes.name: Harbinger of Pestilence
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Pestilences by 50%.

nodes.name: Dread
nodes.description: Damage dealt now has a 15% chance to grant a stack of Dread.At 10 stacks, your next Meatsaw transforms into Annihilation for 8 seconds.AnnihilationAnnihilate up to 10 enemies in a frontal cone, dealing 150% Weapon Damage plus 353 as Shadowflame Damage and generating 4 Demonfire.Deals 20% increased damage if you are above 75% health or below 35% health. Scales with modifiers to Infernal Strike.

nodes.name: Xorothian Sigil
nodes.description: Create a demonic sigil that protects party members within 20 yds of you, causing them to deflect the next harmful spell cast against them within 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Chain Warden
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Chains of Malice by -30 sec, and allows Flesh Hook and Chainwhip to strike up to 2 additional enemies near your primary target.

nodes.name: Warbringer
nodes.description: Transforms your Flames of Xoroth into Warbringer.WarbringerSlam the ground, dealing 65% Weapon Damage plus 2 to nearby enemies, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by -50% for 10 seconds.Deals increased damage per Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Crusher
nodes.description: Level 10 PassiveDoubles the base Weapon Damage dealt by Infernal Strike and increases all critical damage dealt by 25%.

nodes.name: Gore
nodes.description: 2 Charges, 8 sec rechargeGenerates 1 DemonfireQuickly gore an enemy, dealing 100% Weapon Damage plus 15.

nodes.name: Mutilation
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Gore and Sever by 10%.

nodes.name: Gored
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Gore and Meatsaw now increases your target's damage taken from Skulltaker and Warbringer by 15% for 10 seconds, stacking 2 times.

nodes.name: Consuming Blade
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Gore by 25% and your expertise by 5.

nodes.name: Ripper
nodes.description: Level 20 PassiveDamaging abilities that spend Demonfire now refresh a charge of Gore.

nodes.name: Fiend
nodes.description: Casting Sever now removes the cost of your next Infernal Strike.

nodes.name: Hellfire Striker
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike and hit chance by 3%.

nodes.name: Pestilence of Death
nodes.description: Emanate a pestilence, increasing your critical damage by 10%.

nodes.name: Burning Blade
nodes.description: Ignite your weapon, causing you to send out searing fire with each melee critical strike, dealing 270 + 32.5% AP Fire damage in a line and increasing your Armor penetration by 30% while active. Lasts for 6 attacks.Lasts for 1 additional attack per Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Burning Blade
nodes.description: Your Skulltaker now ignores -25% of the target's Armor.

nodes.name: Absolutism
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Meatsaw now ignores -10% of the target's Armor.

nodes.name: Bringer of Destruction
nodes.description: Critical damage taken now grants you 1 Demonfire and 5 Rage. Can only occur once every 3 sec.

nodes.name: Boundless Fury
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of the unleash effect from Pestilence of Death by 30%.

nodes.name: Carver
nodes.description: Level 30 PassiveCritical strikes with Gore now generate 1 additional Demonfire.

nodes.name: Murderous Might
nodes.description: Increases the damage of abilities that spend Demonfire by 25%.

nodes.name: Decimation
nodes.description: Your next Skulltaker or Warbringer is guaranteed to critically strike for 25% increased damage. Lasts 30 seconds.

nodes.name: Screamin' Demon
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Unleash Pestilence by -15 sec.

nodes.name: Burning Swings
nodes.description: Your Burning Blade now affects 4 additional attacks.

nodes.name: Hellsmelted
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance and damage of Burning Blade by 30%.

nodes.name: Hand of Doom
nodes.description: Increases the Weapon Damage dealt by Sever by 10%, increased by 10% for each Demonfire you have active.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Will
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, Physical critical strikes now increase the target's Physical damage taken by 4% for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Hellborn
nodes.description: Generating a stack of Demon's Blood now has a 5% chance to unleash your active Pestilence at half of their effectiveness.

nodes.name: Chop Shop
nodes.description: Each stack of Demon's Blood now increases the critical strike chance of Sever and Meatsaw by 1%.

nodes.name: Render
nodes.description: Level 40 PassiveIncreases your melee haste rating by 30% of your Strength.

nodes.name: Domination
nodes.description: Melee critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of Burning Blade by -1 sec.

nodes.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Flesh Hook and Chainwhip by -5 sec.

nodes.name: Demonic Frenzy
nodes.description: Casting Sever now increases your attack speed by 20% for 10 seconds.Casting Gore extends the duration of this effect by 3 sec.

nodes.name: Jagged Edge
nodes.description: Increases your Rage generated from damage dealt by 20%.

nodes.name: Knight of Pestilence
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your Pestilences by 50%.

nodes.name: The Butcher
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Meatsaw now increases the damage dealt by subsequent Meatsaws by 10% and reduces its global cooldown by -5% for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times.

nodes.name: Brimstone Bludgeon
nodes.description: Transforms your Sever into Brimstone Bludgeon.Brimstone BludgeonGenerates 1 DemonfireBludgeon an enemy and all nearby enemies, dealing 250% Weapon Damage.Unleashes your active Pestilence to trigger a powerful effect.Scales with modifiers to Sever.

nodes.name: Blood Frenzy
nodes.description: Abilities that spend Demonfire now refund 1 Demonfire when used with at least 4 stacks.

nodes.name: Pestilence Unbound
nodes.description: When you use an ability that consumes Demonfire with 6 stacks, you now unleash your active Pestilence at half of their effectiveness.

nodes.name: Knight of the Apocalypse
nodes.description: Level 50 PassiveUnleash Pestilence now triggers no cooldown on it's first use.Unleash Pestilence can only be reset this way once every 30 sec.

nodes.name: Demonic Blade
nodes.description: Damaging abilities that spend Demonfire now increase the damage and cost of your next 2 Gores by 25% for 12 seconds.At the end of the duration, or when all stacks are consumed, you instantly cast Meatsaw free of cost.

nodes.name: Gorged
nodes.description: Gore now heals you for 50% of the damage dealt over 3 sec and grants a stack of Gorged for 30 seconds.At 3 stacks, your next Sever will consume the stacks to leech an additional 200% of the damage dealt by it from up to 5 enemies within 5 yds.In addition, Sever now strikes an additional time after 1 sec but has a 2 increased cooldown.

nodes.name: Hellknight
nodes.description: While above 75% health, all direct Physical damage dealt will grant a stack of Hellknight.HellknightMovement speed increased and global cooldowns reduced by -5%. Physical Damage and critical strike chance increased by 1%, stacking 5 times. Lasts 20 seconds.

nodes.name: Hellmaw
nodes.description: Burn an enemy with a fiery strike, dealing 18 + 10% AP + 18% SP Shadowflame Damage, plus an additional 72 + 56% AP + 57.2% SP over 12 seconds.Deals 20% increased damage per Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Greater Imp
nodes.description: Level 10 PassiveTeaches you Summon: Greater Imp and increases your expertise by 10.Summon: Greater ImpSummon a Greater Imp to aid you in combat.Greater Imp has various combat abilities that provide excellent single target damage and control.

nodes.name: Combusting Blade
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 5% and reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike by -5.

nodes.name: Invasion
nodes.description: All Fire damage dealt is increased by 10% to enemies above 80% health.

nodes.name: Pestilence of Apocalypse
nodes.description: Emanate the Pestilence of Apocalypse, causing nearby enemies to take 10% increased Fire damage from you.

nodes.name: Seeking Flame
nodes.description: Generates 1 DemonfireSear an enemy, dealing 63 + 33.62% fire SP + 33% AP Fire damage.

nodes.name: Burning Power
nodes.description: Level 20 PassiveIncreases your attack power by 100% of your Intellect and your spell damage by 50% of your Strength.

nodes.name: To Ashes
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of abilities that spend Demonfire by 5%.

nodes.name: Hellfire Embers
nodes.description: Increases the Fire damage dealt by your Hellfire Imp by 30% against enemies above 80% maximum health.

nodes.name: Flamewrath
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Seeking Flame by 20%.

nodes.name: Claws of Hell
nodes.description: When you spend at least 4 Demonfire stacks you now refresh the duration of your Unleash Apocalypse on the target.

nodes.name: Calamity
nodes.description: Increases the damage of the Unleash effect of Pestilence of Apocalypse by 25% and its duration is increased by 5 sec.

nodes.name: Hellfire Form
nodes.description: Enter your Hellfire Form, increasing your Fire damage dealt by 20% and Fire critical strike chance by 15% for 15 seconds.

nodes.name: Doom
nodes.description: Transforms your Greater Imp into a Doomguard for 12 seconds.While transformed, your Doomguard deals 20% more damage, and its auto attacks ignite the target, dealing 10% of the damage dealt as Fire damage over 6 seconds, stacking 6 times.

nodes.name: Seething Strikes
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sever by 30% against Burning targets and it now increases the targets chance to be critically struck by 3% for 12 seconds.

nodes.name: Cinderblade
nodes.description: Level 30 PassiveIncreases your critical strike rating by 20% of your Intellect and your spell hit chance by 6%.

nodes.name: Rain of Chaos
nodes.description: Casting Flames of Xoroth with 6 Demonfire now calls down a Rain of Chaos.Rain of ChaosMolten rain burns enemies in the area causing 234 Fire Damage over 9 seconds.

nodes.name: Grotesque
nodes.description: While Hellfire Form is active, your Seeking Flame now has no cooldown and generates an additional Demonfire.

nodes.name: Hellfire Rituals
nodes.description: Critical strikes with Skulltaker now increases the haste of your Greater Imp by 15% for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Infernal Steel
nodes.description: Casting Skulltaker with 6 Demonfire stacks now causes your next Hellmaw within 15 seconds to tick -25% faster and cost -50% less Rage.

nodes.name: Indiscriminate
nodes.description: Seeking Flame now spreads Hellmaw and Melt from the target to up to 3 enemies within 6 yds.

nodes.name: Inferno Blast
nodes.description: Increases your critical damage against Burning targets by 20%.

nodes.name: Infernal Pummeling
nodes.description: Melt now increases the damage your target takes from Flames of Xoroth and Skulltaker by 10%.

nodes.name: Hellbringer
nodes.description: Increases the all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3%.Does not stack with similar effects.

nodes.name: Xorothian Empowerment
nodes.description: Increases the attack power of all party and raid members 5%. Does not stack with similar effects.

nodes.name: Infernal Pursuit
nodes.description: Increases your melee haste by 3% and reduces the duration of root effects against you by -15%.

nodes.name: Impish Pestilence
nodes.description: Level 40 PassiveUsing a Pestilence now applies a Lesser Pestilence to your pet.You can only apply a Lesser Pestilence to your pet every 10 sec.Pestilence of Apocalypse (Pet)Increases the Imps Fire Damage dealt by 10% and allows 50% of its mana regeneration to continue while in combat.Pestilence of Famine (Pet)Damage dealt by the Imp has a 20% chance to reduce the enemy's melee and ranged attack speed by -20% for 6 seconds.Pestilence of Conquest (Pet)Damage dealt by the Imp has a 20% chance to reduce the enemy's Magic Damage dealt by -5% for 5 seconds.Pestilence of War (Pet)Damage dealt by the Imp has a 20% chance to heal you for 1 + 10% AP health.

nodes.name: Partners in Flames
nodes.description: Fire damage dealt by your Greater Imp now has a 25% chance to empower you, increasing your damage dealt by 5% for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Unbound Inferno
nodes.description: Your Infernal Strikes against enemies affected by your Flames of Xoroth now blasts nearby enemies for 75 + 10% fire SP + 5% AP Fire damage.

nodes.name: Brimstone Flames
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Seeking Flame is increased by 20% on enemies affected by Pestilence of Apocalypse.Damage dealt is increased by an additional 10% for each Demonfire you have active.

nodes.name: Brimstone Splinters
nodes.description: Grants Seeking Flame a 30% chance to generate 1 additional Demonfire when it deals damage.Chance to trigger is increased by 5% for each Demonfire you have active.

nodes.name: Shadowflame Forge
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Hellmaw by 3 sec.

nodes.name: Into the Maw
nodes.description: Hellmaw causes a Hellfire Explosion at the end of its duration, dealing additional Fire damage to all nearby enemies within 5 yards equal to 50% of the periodic damage dealt over the duration.

nodes.name: Punisher
nodes.description: Increases the attack power and spell power scaling of Seeking Flame by 25%.

nodes.name: Evil Duo
nodes.description: Level 50 PassiveUnleashing a Pestilence now causes your Greater Imp to unleash it's Pestilence.The Imp's unleash effect is equivalent to your own unleash effect for the equivalent Pestilence.

nodes.name: Hellstorm
nodes.description: Create a hellstorm, dealing 77 + 32.04% fire SP + 8% AP Fire damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.Embers then flare every 1 sec for 2 seconds, dealing 28 + 2.5% fire SP + 2.5% AP Fire damage.Duration is increased by 100% for each stack of Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Ascended Warlock
nodes.description: Your Skulltaker used with 6 stacks of Demonfire now reduces the cooldown of Doom by -5 seconds.In addition, while Doom is active, your Doomguard will now copy your Skulltaker, dealing reduced damage.

nodes.name: Fury of Xoroth
nodes.description: Infernal Strike now grants you a stack of Xorothian Fury, increasing the chance for your next Skulltaker within 10 seconds to critically strike by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks.Additionally, using Skulltaker with 6 stacks of Demonfire grants you Xorothian Rage, causing your next Infernal Strike within 10 seconds to be guaranteed to critically strike.

nodes.name: Shieldgore
nodes.description: Transforms your Infernal Strike into Shieldgore.ShieldgoreGenerates 2 DemonfireGore the target with your spiked shield, causing 21 + 35% AP High Threat Fire Damage, scaling with your block value.

nodes.name: Brimstone Buckler
nodes.description: Level 10 PassiveSuccessful blocks now have a 30% chance to summon 1 Hellfire Imp to aid you in battle for 12 seconds. Can only occur once every 3 sec.

nodes.name: Call: Hellfire Imp
nodes.description: Generates 2 DemonfireBeckon 1 Hellfire Imp to aid you in battle for 12 seconds and generate 20 Rage.Threat generated by Hellfire Imps is transferred to you.

nodes.name: A Gift from Hell
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike, Meatsaw, and Melt by -10.

nodes.name: Imp Gang Boss
nodes.description: Your Call: Hellfire Imp now summons 2 additional imps.

nodes.name: Impcaller
nodes.description: Transforms your Call: Hellfire Imp into Impcaller.Impcaller (Aura)Your Infernal Strike now summons a Hellfire Imp to aid you in combat for 10 seconds, but its Rage cost is increased by 10.In addition, the maximum health of your imps is increased by 30%.

nodes.name: Hellsmelted Armor
nodes.description: Each Hellfire Imp active now increases your chance to block by 1%.

nodes.name: Imp Guards
nodes.description: Level 20 PassiveEach Hellfire Imp now reduces your Physical damage taken by 1%.

nodes.name: Bulwark of Xoroth
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Shieldgore will now apply Torn Flesh, causing the target to bleed for 105 over 15 seconds.

nodes.name: Warden of Hellfire
nodes.description: Increases the damage dealt by Skulltaker and Flames of Xoroth by 20%.

nodes.name: Hellfire Forgemaster
nodes.description: Increases your block value by 20%.

nodes.name: Sacrificial Circle
nodes.description: Sacrifice your Hellfire Imps within 15 yds, healing you 15% of your maximum health, plus an additional amount equal to 25% of each of your Hellfire Imp's maximum health.Hellfire Imps sacrificed in this way leave behind corpses.

nodes.name: Demonfire Retaliation
nodes.description: Grants you a 30% chance to generate a stack of Demonfire when attacked.

nodes.name: Hellish Rebuke
nodes.description: Generating a stack of Demon's Blood now has a 15% chance to trigger a fiery explosion on up to 5 nearby enemies, dealing 96 Fire damage.

nodes.name: Implosion
nodes.description: Explode with hellish fire, dealing 51 + 25% Strength + 50% fire SP + 10% AP Fire damage to nearby enemies, beckoning Hellfire Imps to aid you in battle for 12 seconds, and generating 30 Rage.Deals increased damage and increases the amount of imps summoned by 1 for each Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Hellfire Reprimand
nodes.description: Your Hellfire Imps now have a 20% chance on hit to launch a firebolt dealing 40% Strength Fire damage and reducing enemy attack power by 190 for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Soul Furnace
nodes.description: Sacrificial Circle now grants you a damage absorption shield equal to 15% of the total health of each destroyed imp for 10 sec.

nodes.name: Hellfire Resolve
nodes.description: Level 30 PassiveIncreases your block rating by 15% of your Strength and increases your hit rating by 5% of your Strength.

nodes.name: Demon's Breath
nodes.description: Critical strikes with Shieldgore now unleash an eruption of hellfire, causing 111 + 20% AP Fire damage and generating 1 additional Demonfire.

nodes.name: Demonfire Command
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Implosion by -10 sec and its Rage cost by -5.

nodes.name: Infernal Bulwark
nodes.description: Casting Unleash Pestilence now generates 4 stacks of Demonfire and grants Infernal Bulwark.Infernal Bulwark (Proc)Increases block value by 20% for 18 seconds.

nodes.name: Stoke the Flames
nodes.description: Your Skulltaker and Melt used with 6 Demonfire now refund 2 Demonfire.Skulltaker used with 6 Demonfire now deals an additional 30% Fire damage.

nodes.name: Brimstone Knight
nodes.description: Increases your Fire damage dealt by 3% and dealing Fire damage increases the enemy spell damage taken by 10% for 15 seconds.

nodes.name: Speed Demon
nodes.description: Your Suffuse now increases your movement speed by 20%.

nodes.name: Chains of Xoroth
nodes.description: Create demonic chains at target location that slow enemies inside by -80% for 5 seconds. At the end of the duration, it pulls all affected enemies to it.

nodes.name: Pestilent Retaliation
nodes.description: When you block an attack you now have a 5% chance to unleash your active Pestilence at half of its effectiveness.Can only occur once every 5 sec.

nodes.name: Forgefiend's Bulwark
nodes.description: Successful blocks, parries and dodges now have a 30% chance to Enrage you, increasing your damage dealt by 10% for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Imp Aura
nodes.description: Level 40 PassiveEach Hellfire Imp now reduces your Magic damage taken by 1%.

nodes.name: Hellfire Sieger
nodes.description: Doubles the absorption of Black Shield while below 35% health.

nodes.name: Brimstone Striker
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Stoke the Flames now reduces the cooldown of Sever and Juggernaut by -4 sec.

nodes.name: Demolisher
nodes.description: Casting Flesh Hook or Chainwhip now taunts the target for 2 seconds and reduces your Physical damage taken by -5% for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Hellfire Bellows
nodes.description: Transforms your Flames of Xoroth into Hellfire Bellows.Hellfire BellowsBellow fire on all enemies in a 6 yd cone in front of and behind you, dealing 252 + 17.63% AP + 40% fire SP Fire damage and reducing the cooldown of Chains of Xoroth by -4 sec per enemy hit.Cooldown is reduced by -3 sec for each Demonfire consumed.

nodes.name: Black Skull Shield
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of Shieldgore by -5 and increases its damage by 25%.

nodes.name: Demonic Grit
nodes.description: Grant your summons demonic grit, increasing their total health by 15% and reducing their damage taken by by 10%.

nodes.name: Fiend of Forges
nodes.description: Forgefiend's Bulwark now also increases your critical strike chance by 10%.

nodes.name: Hellwrath
nodes.description: Your Demon's Blood can now stack 5 additional times and each stack now increases the absorption amount of Black Shield by 1%.

nodes.name: Curse of Xoroth
nodes.description: Curse an enemy for 15 seconds, dealing 1575 + 100% AP Shadowflame Damage over 15 seconds.Your next Shieldgore within 12 seconds grants you Black Shield, absorbing 860 + 200% Stamina damage for 30 seconds.

nodes.name: Fiery Retribution
nodes.description: Each time a Hellfire Imp dies, you reduce the cooldown of Sacrificial Circle by -2 sec and Implosion by -1 sec.

nodes.name: Demonic Bulwark
nodes.description: Level 50 PassiveYour successful blocks now have a 30% chance to critically block for twice the normal amount.Chance to trigger is increased by 2% for each Hellfire Imp you have active.

nodes.name: Call: Hellfire Abyssal
nodes.description: Call down a Hellfire Abyssal from the sky to crash down upon the targeted 8 yd area, dealing 1500 + 100% SP + 100% AP Fire damage.The abyssal remains to aid you in battle for 15 seconds and emits an aura that reduces the damage taken by party and raid members within 40 yds by -5%.Costs -15 less Rage for each active Hellfire Imp.

nodes.name: A Curse from Hell
nodes.description: Periodic damage dealt now has a 15% chance to reduce the cooldown of Curse of Xoroth by -3 sec.Chance to trigger is increased by 2% for each stack of Demonfire active.

nodes.name: Legion's Presence
nodes.description: Emanate an aura to all party and raid members within 25 yds for 15 seconds, increasing their damage dealt by 10%.Fire damage dealt by Hellfire Imps is increased by 150% and total health increased by 50% while this effect is active on them.
